record.title: Tape 677, Conversation 010 (677-010)
record.scopeAndContentNote: On March 6, 1972, President Richard M. Nixon, H. R. ("Bob") Haldeman, John D. Ehrlichman, and Alexander P. Butterfield met in the Oval Office of the White House from 12:31 pm to 1:28 pm.
